headline: Vixy digs items
title: Vixy | Dig Up Items At Your Ranch | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want free items in Palworld one point zero? Vixy is a tiny Neutral Pal, and its partner skill, Dig Here, sometimes digs up items from the ground when you assign it to a ranch. It has Gathering level one and Farming level one, so it is a cheap starter for your first ranch. Will you ranch a Vixy? Comment below!
description: Vixy in Palworld 1.0 is a Neutral Pal that sometimes digs up items at a ranch, with Gathering and Farming level one.
